title: Alsatian Croissant Sandwich
description: A delicious sandwich made with flaky croissants and savory Alsatian sausage.
instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
Slice the cooked sausage and cook it in the pan until lightly browned.
Butter one side of each croissant.
Assemble the sandwiches by placing a few slices of sausage, a sprinkle of shredded cheese, a few pieces of chopped onion, and a sprig of thyme onto the unbuttered side of a croissant.
Place the other croissant on top, buttered side up.
Cook the sandwiches in the pan for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve immediately, with additional bread on the side if desired.
